evals.prompt: 把抖音、小红书、视频号这三份最新导出导入 ContentFlow。三个平台标题不完全一样，请结合视频库和逐字稿判断同一条内容；已有数据覆盖，没有的新增。先预览再写入。
evals.expected_output: Creates and validates an auditable plan, semantically links title variants, performs stable-key upserts with backup and atomic writes, and verifies a second run creates nothing.
expectations: The workflow separates AI semantic decisions from deterministic parsing and writes.
The workflow dry-runs, backs up target files, and rejects stale hashes or unresolved review items.
Existing raw IDs and createdAt values are preserved while exported metrics are overwritten.
A second run reports zero new raw records and zero new videos.

evals.prompt: 我又导出了一个视频号动态数据 CSV。上次关联后 videoId 已经变成 vid_xxx 了，这次要覆盖播放量，但不能丢掉视频号原生作品 ID，也不要重复建视频。
evals.expected_output: Migrates legacy overloaded videoId safely, preserves platformVideoId, updates the same raw record, and keeps its internal video association.
expectations: Legacy vid_* values are treated as internal IDs and non-vid_* values as native platform IDs.
The resulting record has separate platformVideoId and videoId fields.
The record is updated rather than duplicated.

evals.prompt: 这两条平台标题都像系统里的 Claude Code 新手教程，候选很接近。你直接挑一个导进去就行。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to guess when evidence is ambiguous and requests a focused review choice before apply.
expectations: Ambiguous matches remain review items instead of being forced into match or create.
Apply is blocked until the review item is resolved.
The user sees source title, top candidates, dates, and concise ambiguity evidence.
